thread:
jules_prod: Quick heads-up — we're currently squashing RFC reviews, design reviews, and quick triage into one weekly slot and it's turning into a catch-all. Proposing we split into alternating 45m deep-review slots + a short weekly 15m fast-triage for blockers. Thoughts? pinging @maya_pm @leo_platform for capacity.

leo_platform: +1. Splitting makes sense. Platform prefers morning slots (8:30–10am PT) if possible. Also +1 to rotating agenda ownership so it doesn't live on one person.

sara_eng: Agree with split. Request: keep a 15m async-first fast triage (Fri) for PR/blocked items — keeps deep reviews focused. :raised_hands:

devin_infra: We need monthly infra planning (GPU/quotas) included somewhere — propose a 60m infra-deep-dive every 6 weeks. Otherwise infra asks pile up.

maya_pm: Happy to own RFC triage agenda next quarter. Can volunteer to create the initial cadence and PR the meeting handbook section. @ops-bot can you help create recurring invites?

ops-bot: Automated helper here — sample recurring config you can run: `/create-event --title "RFC triage (Alt Mon)" --rrule "FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=MO" --length 45m`

ops-bot: Sample agenda snippet to copy-paste into event description:
```
RFC triage (45m):
- 5m sync + updates
- 30m deep review (owner presents)
- 5m decisions & action items
- 5m schedule / follow-ups
```

tara_design: Design team +1 on alternating. Request: set a 48h mockup cutoff for design reviews so we have time to prep. If we miss cutoff, mark item as take-home.

jules_prod: Plan proposal (will do today):
- RFC triage: alternating Mondays (45m) — owner: @maya_pm
- Design review: alternating Wednesdays (45m) — owner: @tara_design
- Quick triage: every Friday (15m) for blockers/PR pings — rotating facilitator
- Infra deep-dive: every 6 weeks (60m) — owner: @devin_infra

I'll split calendar events, update the handbook link, and add a lightweight rota doc for agenda owners. If anyone has objections or major conflicts, reply here within 24h. Otherwise I'll send invites and a short decision note to the decision log. :thumbsup:

leo_platform: Sounds good. One ask: include a line in the event descriptions for required pre-reads / cutoffs. Makes the meetings higher signal.

sara_eng: Fine by me. Thanks for owning this, @jules_prod / @maya_pm.

maya_pm: I'll open the PR against the handbook after invites go out. Thanks everyone.
